answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its vine recurs, its tundra survives audit, and a tide from an unlinked peer confirms it.
